notes.note: Fix round 4 of the delivery-state change: another window's queue-change notice only re-projects (it no longer starts a flush, and a held copy listed from another window no longer counts as a waiting row); public outbox rows carry sendUnderWay only while the claiming renderer's Web Lock is held, so the list reads Sending only then and the bubble agrees; Discard… stays mounted and the shared confirmation takes and returns focus; the composer's confirmation opens as its own popover; the phone sheet's inline actions are a group of buttons; the accepted outbox note reads in sentence case and outbox text wraps and clamps to two lines. The Sending… bullet now also covers a message another open window of the app is sending (the bubble reads sendUnderWay through messageDeliveryStateFor). Re-read the delivery list and the Discard… paragraph against MessageDeliveryNote, deliveryLabels.ts and the composer popover; the remaining labels and actions are unchanged.
